author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
Tonight I strolled into our college dive bar
Only to find the graffiti
Coated with the invetibale crawl
Of concrete and capitalism
Incapuslated in my corrupted corner...
A comedy night
Where performers were
the only patrons
Saddend to see our castle
fall
Yet inspired by interlopers
I climbed the walls
And performed a set.
A first in a forgotten place.
I figure, I teach; Is comedy different?
If I can make algebra enjoyable
I must be within two standard deviations
of funny.
